title: fix: community monitor stops probing agents
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Community monitor no longer covers agents (`agent: true`): probe sweep, 7-day audit and CYCLE.md rules all skip them
- Probes made public agents do real work on the monitor's account: `community/xiaotian1171/bottle-courier` committed to collective-memory as voodoohop about every 45 min (key `quixotic-hare`)
- Agent health follows their base model, which is still monitored

gist.headline: Agents Get a Day Off
gist.blurb: The community monitor has learned that agents are not ordinary garden visitors. It now watches their base models instead of sending probe bees into their workspaces.
gist.summary: Updated the community monitor’s probe sweep, seven-day audit, and CYCLE.md rules to skip entries marked `agent: true`, while continuing to track each agent through its monitored base model.
gist.impact: Automated community agents such as `community/xiaotian1171/bottle-courier` can keep doing their intended work without monitor probes using the monitor account, while base-model health coverage remains in place.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-monitoring scene where Polli gently redirects an eager CRT monitor robot away from a small agent workshop, while a larger healthy base-model code-plant is checked from a respectful distance. A “SKIP AGENTS” sign and orderly monitoring clipboard make the new routing rule visible without portraying agents as broken.
